submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE independent full-body game animation frame on real transparent RGBA square canvas at least 1024 pixels. NOT a sprite sheet.
Image1 is exact character identity, WEST screen-left orientation, camera, global scale and virtual ground reference. Image2 is the approved primary rendering/style reference only: bright clean rounded Taoist chibi hand-painted volume.
Character 09 bamboo archer girl: same brown high ponytail, green eyes, bamboo gold-jade hair ornament, ivory green gold short robe, white shorts, short green-white boots. Anatomical LEFT hand firmly wraps the grip of ONE complete tall bamboo bow; anatomical RIGHT hand does the action; quiver remains fixed over anatomical RIGHT shoulder. Preserve costume motifs and original short body/large head ratio. Full bow tips, feet, hands, ponytail visible with transparent margin. W profile looking to screen LEFT. Keep scale and composition of image1, ground near y=940 on a 1024 canvas, fixed root around x450. NO per-frame recentering, no effect particles, no shadow floor, text or UI.
Image3 is preceding continuity reference. Keep EXACTLY same character scale, bow size, camera, baseline and root position. Move joints only.
Animation hit/W/04, phase 回弹.
Pose: 核心带动上身前回，膝盖开始伸展；右臂仍护身但肘部放松，马尾与衣摆继续向后惯性摆动。
Direction: 目标位于屏幕左。受击时上身向屏幕右退让，回弹向左恢复；射击/施法弓与箭朝左。不得将E图镜像取得W图。
Transition: 相较03，头肩开始回到待机一侧，身体后仰幅度明显减少，头发/衣摆惯性与躯干回弹错相。 相较04，重心更稳定、右手更低，衣摆和马尾摆幅开始衰减；脚底仍不整帧滑移。
Now rebound from recoil: straighten torso halfway toward vertical, lower chin slightly, right forearm relaxes but still protects chest. Knees extend somewhat. Keep both planted feet fixed. No arrows held.
One independent distinct moment; coherent separated legs and boots; exact anatomical left bow hand and right action hand. No effects, detached projectiles, floor or text.
